name: nh3h2o_absorption_two_stage
title: Two-stage ammonia-water absorption system with condensate precooling
summary: Two-stage (double-effect) NH3H2O absorption refrigeration cycle, Herold, Radermacher and Klein Example 10.1: Desorber 1 is driven internally by the heat of Absorber 2 and Rectifier 2, three rectifiers purify the vapour and a condensate precooler (RHX) subcools the condensed liquid; all 29 state points, the component heat rates and the COP are computed.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two heat rates)

origin.notes: Example 10.1 of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: The runnable variant was compared with the EES stored solution (same inputs, kPa/kJ converted; the native file is blocked): COP 0.479 vs 0.496 (3.5 %), pressures within 1.0 %, mass flows within 5.0 %. Whole-cycle balance closes to 1.6e-6 W. Deviations explained by the NH3H2O property backend (identical calls differ up to 6 %); dilute-loop compositions up to 54 % (x[19]).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the binary Ex10_1.EES (ees_variables.csv), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units; direct NH3H2O property calls at identical inputs quantify the backend difference
verification.notes: Compared set: 241 common variables. Excluded: h*, swp*, s[i] (NH3H2O reference-state offsets; the EES s[i] records are stale: the file computes no entropy), checkQ (balance residual: EES -2.3 mW, CoolSolve 1.6e-6 W on 271.5 kW). Max rel diff as printed: x[19] 5.36e-01; COP 3.45e-02; P[12] 1.01e-02; T[26] 3.43e-02. Q_dot_des_2 has no stored EES value (implied 179.5 kW from COP_c, CoolSolve 181.5 kW).

related_external: EES example ex10_1_mass.ees (mass-balance-only teaching subset of the same cycle, candidate EEX-078)

history.action: added (native file blocked by CS-BUG-PROP-QLIMIT; runnable _coolsolve variant compared with the EES stored solution)
